answer: Reaching the ridge of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Every claim climbs the atlas of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the river re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, released only after three unrelated confirmations, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short.
